records.academicNote: Bachelor in a relevant subject or accepted equivalent, with a possible qualifying examination. Urban Policy/Management and Urban Technology/Analytics are curriculum streams within one 69-credit award. Curriculum mentions of AI, finance or digital tools are not exclusive undergraduate degrees or fixed employment years. CV, personal statement and academic/applicable English evidence remain assessed.

Named design/art/landscape/architecture, ecology, garden/horticulture design, urban planning/design and environmental design backgrounds; other disciplines with exceptional talent, achievement or skills may be considered. No absolute GPA or essential work experience is set in the FAQ. A4 portfolio up to20 pages/30MB, at least THREE university-studio projects, 150-200-word methods statement, credited collaborators/instructors and two referees require review. Oral IELTS6 is preferred, not a mandatory component threshold. Interview/assessment and overseas field/joint-studio arrangements remain assessed.

Recognised bachelor or accepted equivalent, possible qualifying examination and shortlisted interview. No exclusive undergraduate major, numeric GPA or fixed employment-year threshold is established in the consulted current requirements. Two referees, preferably at least one academic, plus CV, statement and academic/applicable English evidence. The portal describes FT one-to-two and PT two-to-three years; the proposed fee is per programme, not per maximum year.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent, possible qualifying examination and interview. No exclusive undergraduate major, numeric GPA or fixed work years is established. Two referees, preferably at least one academic, and supporting evidence remain assessed. Optional major/career descriptions are not extra awards. Eligible PT entrance scholarship and merit awards are not automatic tuition deductions.

Three-year MArch(Design) accepts honours bachelor/equivalent in Science, Engineering or Arts; degree-award types are not an exclusive undergraduate-major list or a specific honours-class threshold. Architectural Studies graduates may be considered depending on prior curriculum. Current supporting PDF requires two referees, at least one academic, and an interest statement up to500 words; a landscape PDF portfolio up to20 pages/30MB is OPTIONAL. The webpage still gives April2026; use the current January2027 portal/PDF and do not carry over that old deadline.

Recognised bachelor/equivalent and possible qualifying examination. Curriculum topics BIM, GIS, AI, blockchain and gaming do not create a mandatory computing major or work-year floor. The 72-credit programme retains FT and PT. Eligible PT scholarship and individual merit awards are not guaranteed discounts; full current supporting evidence still needs assessment.

Architecture, Engineering, Surveying, Environmental Science, Geography or related qualification. The portal mentions honours/equivalence without an exact class; professional membership is preferred, not mandatory. Research-focused teaching is within a taught MSc, not an inferred research-master exclusion. Possible assessment and evidence remain required; field/joint-studio charges are separate.
